valuation.basis: current market cap vs the annual period both statements cover
valuation.pe_withheld_reason: Withheld: the period FY2026 reports no positive net profit, so a P/E is not defined. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.earnings_yield_withheld_reason: Withheld: the earnings behind the earnings yield are not verified: the period FY2026 reports no positive net profit, so a P/E is not defined. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.ev_ebit_withheld_reason: Withheld: EBIT and net debt are not both on file for FY2026, so EV/EBIT cannot be built. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.note: loss-making in the latest period, so P/E is not meaningful
valuation.psFormula: current price / revenue per share, where revenue per share = revenue / shares outstanding
valuation.psRevenueRow: the income statement's revenue line for FY2026, read from the row labelled 'Revenue'
valuation.psSharesSource: the same 7.34383e+08 shares behind the market capitalisation (static_data\market_JSE.json)
valuation.peg_withheld_reason: Withheld: the P/E a PEG divides is itself withheld, so there is no P/E to divide by the growth rate. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.pb_withheld_reason: Withheld: the total-equity row the P/B divides is an order of magnitude from its own adjacent year (FY2025 1.0965e+10 against FY2024 -2.93e+08), so the book value for FY2026 is not verified. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
